text: わざマシン０３は　みずのはどうを　ポケモンに　おしえるの　みずに　すむ　ポケモンに　つかって　あげて！

structure.jp: みずのはどうを　ポケモンに　おしえるの
structure.en: teaches Water Pulse to a Pokémon, you see

structure.jp: みずに　すむ　ポケモンに
structure.en: on a Pokémon that lives in the water

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form means doing the thing as a favour to someone. The final て makes it a casual request. つかって　あげて = 'go and use it for them'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みずに　すむ　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in an action word placed right before a thing describes that thing. みずに　すむ　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon that lives in the water'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement is a soft, feminine form of のだ, used when explaining something. おしえるの = 'it teaches it, you see'.
